images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: Folk House St

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a front-gabled Craftsman bungalow with a gable window, a full porch with square posts and a balustrade, an ivy-covered foursquare next door, a garage at the end of the side drive
